levelDefinitions.I3: approved bounded effect with poststate verification
levelDefinitions.I4: destructive/privileged/high-risk effect requiring separate admission and stronger oracle

requirements: Every Product job is derived from the original PRD §2 and L1 with a later exact Product freeze; not from candidate API lists.
Every job separately traces to an existing Element, Claim, CQ and source ID; all links are candidate knowledge, not SAP qualification.
Every future expanded capability is NOT_ADMITTED and has no approved DIS Function.
Tool/API availability does not imply Shun implementation, execution authority, or Windows edition/build support.
Preview is not effect; Function self-reported success does not meet independent poststate.
AOT stable knowledge excludes live device state, permissions, grants/permits, user data or runtime receipts.
All cost/frequency/user-value scores remain UNKNOWN until evidence exists.
No native Windows DKE execution/independent reviewer is claimed in this file.
